room.detailed_description: They say a great hotel stay is a memorable one, and there will be no forgetting the King Room, a space where anything could happen. Subtle textures, luxurious fabrics, Deco inspired black glass panelling, pillow toppers, an elegantly chic bar and monotone bathrooms are in tune with the distinct Royce mood. Classical with a touch of modern style. Our Deluxe Rooms offer an intimate and cosy oasis to return to after your adventures. We haven’t held back on the indulgence so why should you?

room.detailed_description: You can never have too much of a good thing. Which is why we offer some select King Rooms with their own balconies. The same generous space, equally lavish and indulgent – but with a private balcony where you can relax and enjoy the fresh air and the light Melbourne breeze. A perfect place to ask some of the big questions in life – like, will you breakfast in the room or in the Conservatory, how many bottles of Champagne does it take to fill a room service trolley, and is it too early for a Martini? Our Deluxe Balcony room is an invitation to spoil yourself, more than just a little. And by the way, the answers are – both, let’s find out and never.

room.detailed_description: After soaking in bubbles in the decadent bathtub and swanning around the opulent bathroom, you wrap yourself cocoon-like in a robe and reach for your cocktail. Being fabulous is encouraged. The escape continues as the light chinking of wine glasses and lilting banter drifts through the evening from the inner courtyard and Conservatory and gently caresses your ears. It beckons and you are torn between living it up in your lavish suite or joining the buzz of the hotel’s nightlife. Why choose when you can have both? Too much of a good thing can be just what you need sometimes.

room.detailed_description: Our grand trinity, these three exclusive suites are statements in style. Each is lavishly appointed, with a luxury of space including a private landscaped terrace. Celebrate the best of both worlds – the rich interior where you are surrounded by creative flourishes and bold design that anticipates your moods and desires – and the outside world, invited in with grand windows and your terrace with sweeping views of Melbourne’s dazzling cityscape. Perched on the topmost floor of The Royce, you can bask in al fresco high living with an iconic cocktail while you reflect on the day, or the evening shenanigans to come. Plan on being very nice to our staff if you want one of these suites.

room.detailed_description: Our Boulevard Suites are a celebration of the classic premium hotel suites of the golden age. Spacious and lush, grand bathrooms and bathtubs for the pleasure-loving. A gilt-edge choice for a romantic escape where you can loiter elegantly in a robe, roaming between the lounge, the sink-in bed, the curated mini-bar or the grand bathtub. The Boulevard Suites are also the ideal space for mixing business and pleasure. Schmooze with your favourite clients or take a well-deserved breather between pitches, in the separate lux living room, work or play, or a bit of both, these suites are designed for taking your indulgence up a notch.

room.detailed_description: We’ve named them Loft Suites because they embody the classic New York loft style apartment, but… with an opulent twist. Open, light-filled, with soaring ceilings and double height windows that were once car service bays in the historical Rolls Royce showroom. Saunter between the sitting room on the lower level and the lavish bedroom and bathroom oasis upstairs. With a second bathroom downstairs, these suites are perfect for entertaining friends or corporate guests, with quaint side street views and impressive levels of privacy and comfort.

You don’t need our permission to live it up, but this is the suite that makes it all possible. Swan around celebrity style revelling in the luxury of space and natural light. Feel presidential lolling in the king-size bed, only rising to the promise of picturesque views of the city skyline over treetops, or a glass of champagne in the bathtub, deep and indulgent it would make Cleopatra blush. Fit for a queen, staying in the Royce Suite takes you away to another time and place, you may never want to leave.

info.description:
The Royce is located on Melbourne’s grand boulevard that connects the city’s finest luxury shopping on Collins Street, to world-class galleries and gardens and further to the beautiful bayside beaches.

Intuitive service, lavish detail and flamboyant flourishes distinguish The Royce. The building’s luxurious origins are on full display, from the grand staircase to the statement chandelier in the Ballroom. This awe-inspiring glamour is echoed in the splashes of marble, chrome, and classical black and white in the suites where no expense has been spared.

The Bar serves iconic cocktails by a cosy open fireplace. The wine and gossip flow in the radiant Bistro and Conservatory. 

The Royce ballroom is a return to the great era of celebrity-scale weddings, where guests stay over and kick on into the night.

Hollywood-style opulence meets contemporary convenience in the rooms, with electronic window furnishings, individual climate control, complimentary Wi-Fi and movies, Dyson Supersonic hairdryers, Koko Black chocolates and Molton Brown toiletries.
